title.zh: 卷八十四 晉書10: 少帝本紀四
title.en: Volume 84 Book of Later Jin 10: Emperor Shao 3
title.raw: 卷八十四 晉書10: 少帝本紀四 Volume 84 Book of Later Jin 10: Emperor Shao 3

sentences.zh: 開運二年夏五月丙申朔，帝御崇元殿受朝，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kaiyun, on the first day bingchen of the fifth summer month, the emperor took the throne at Chongyuan Hall to receive court homage and proclaimed a general amnesty for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaiyun 2, on the first day bingchen of the fifth summer month, the emperor held court at Chongyuan Hall, received homage, and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以右衛上將軍馬萬為左金吾上將軍致仕。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Ma Wan, General of the Right Guard, was made retired General of the Left Golden Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Ma Wan, General of the Right Guard, was retired as General of the Left Golden Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，陜州節度使宋彥筠移鎮鄧州，澶州節度使何建移鎮河陽。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Song Yanyun, military commissioner of Shaan Prefecture, was transferred to Deng Prefecture, and He Jian, military commissioner of Chan Prefecture, was transferred to Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Song Yanyun moved from Shaan to Deng Prefecture, and He Jian from Chan to Heyang.

sentences.zh: 以左神武統軍潘環為澶州節度使，以宣徽北院使李彥韜遙領壽州節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使，以滄州節度使田武遙領夔州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Pan Huan, commander of the Left Divine Martial Army, was made military commissioner of Chan Prefecture; Li Yantao, commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was given concurrent remote command of Shou Prefecture and made commander of the Palace Guards Cavalry; Tian Wu, military commissioner of Cang Prefecture, was given concurrent remote command of Kui Prefecture and made commander of the Palace Guards Infantry.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Huan became commissioner of Chan; Li Yantao held Shou remotely while commanding the palace cavalry; Tian Wu held Kui remotely while commanding the palace infantry.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On xinhai, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai a white rainbow spanned the sun.

sentences.zh: 壬子，宰臣桑維翰、劉句、李崧、和凝並加階爵。

translations.literal: On renzi, the chief ministers Sang Weihan, Liu Xu, Li Song, and He Ning were all advanced in rank and enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi chief ministers Sang Weihan, Liu Xu, Li Song, and He Ning all received higher ranks and fiefs.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書竇貞固改刑部尚書，太常寺卿王松改工部尚書。

translations.literal: Dou Zhengu, Minister of Rites, was changed to Minister of Justice; Wang Song, Director of the Directorate of Ceremonies, was changed to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Zhengu moved from Rites to Justice, and Wang Song from Ceremonies to Works.

sentences.zh: 以尚書左丞龍敏為太常卿；

translations.literal: Long Min, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Director of Ceremonies;
translations.idiomatic: Long Min, Left Vice Director of State Affairs, became Director of Ceremonies;

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎李慎儀為尚書左丞；

translations.literal: Li Shenyi, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shenyi, Hanlin chief academician and Vice Minister of War, became Left Vice Director of State Affairs;

sentences.zh: 以御史中丞張允為兵部侍郎、知制誥，充翰林學士承旨；

translations.literal: Zhang Yun, Censor-in-Chief, was made Vice Minister of War, drafter of imperial rescripts, and appointed Hanlin Academician-in-Chief;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yun, Censor-in-Chief, became Vice Minister of War and drafter of rescripts and Hanlin chief academician;

sentences.zh: 以左諫議大夫顏衎為御史中丞；

translations.literal: Yan Kan, Left Remonstrance Counselor, was made Censor-in-Chief;
translations.idiomatic: Yan Kan, Left Remonstrance Counselor, became Censor-in-Chief;

sentences.zh: 〈（《宋史·顏衎傳》：喪亂之後，朝綱不振，衎執憲頗有風采，嘗上言：「才除御史者旋授外藩賓佐，復有以私故細事求假外拜，州郡無參謁之儀，出入失風憲之體，漸恐四方得以輕易，百辟無所準繩。

translations.literal: (Biography of Yan Kan in the Song History: After the disorders, court discipline was slack; Kan in enforcing the law showed considerable authority and once memorialized: "Those just made censors are immediately appointed as staff to outer prefectures; moreover some seek leave for minor private matters to go out and take provincial posts, so that prefectures have no protocol for audiences, and coming and going lose the dignity proper to the censorate—gradually the four quarters may take things lightly and the hundred officials have no standard to follow.
translations.idiomatic: (Song History, biography of Yan Kan: After the civil wars court discipline had slackened; Kan enforced the law with notable vigor and once memorialized: "Newly appointed censors are immediately sent as staff to frontier prefectures, and others use petty private pretexts to leave the capital for provincial posts. Prefectures then lack proper audience protocol, and the censorate loses its dignity—soon the realm may hold it in contempt and officials will have no standard.

sentences.zh: 請自今藩鎮幕僚，勿得任臺官；

translations.literal: I request that from now on prefectural staff may not hold censorate posts;
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth let prefectural staff not hold censorate posts;

sentences.zh: 雖親王宰相出鎮，亦不得奏充賓佐；

translations.literal: even when imperial princes or chief ministers go out to command prefectures, they may not be recommended as staff;
translations.idiomatic: even when princes or chief ministers take field commands, they may not be named as staff;

sentences.zh: 非奉制勘事，勿得出京；

translations.literal: except on imperial commission to investigate matters, they may not leave the capital;
translations.idiomatic: and except on imperial commission to investigate, censors may not leave the capital;

sentences.zh: 自余不令釐雜務。」

translations.literal: as for the rest, do not allow them to take on miscellaneous duties."
translations.idiomatic: nor handle miscellaneous duties."

sentences.zh: 詔惟辟召入幕，余從其請。）〉

translations.literal: An edict allowed only those summoned by imperial appointment to enter staffs; the rest of his requests were approved.)〉
translations.idiomatic: The edict allowed only imperial summons to enter staffs; the rest was approved.)〉

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎、宏文館學士、判館事田敏為國子祭酒；

translations.literal: Tian Min, Vice Minister of War, academician of the Hongwen Hall, and overseer of the hall, was made Chancellor of the Directorate of Education;
translations.idiomatic: Tian Min, Vice Minister of War and Hongwen academician, became Chancellor of the Directorate of Education;

sentences.zh: 以戶部侍郎段希堯為兵部侍郎；

translations.literal: Duan Xiyao, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War;
translations.idiomatic: Duan Xiyao, Vice Minister of Revenue, became Vice Minister of War;

sentences.zh: 以工部侍郎邊蔚為戶部侍郎，依前權知開封府事；

translations.literal: Bian Wei, Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Revenue and continued as before as acting overseer of Kaifeng Prefecture affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Bian Wei, Vice Minister of Works, became Vice Minister of Revenue while retaining acting charge of Kaifeng;

sentences.zh: 以左散騎常侍李式為工部侍郎；

translations.literal: Li Shi, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made Vice Minister of Works;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, became Vice Minister of Works;

sentences.zh: 以給事中王仁裕為左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Wang Renyu, Supervising Secretary, was made Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Renyu, Supervising Secretary, became Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以華州節度使趙瑩為開封尹，以皇弟開封尹重睿為秦州節度使，以宣徽南院使劉繼勛為華州節度使，以前鄆州節度使張從恩為晉州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Zhao Ying, military commissioner of Hua Prefecture, was made Prefect of Kaifeng; the emperor's younger brother Chongrui, Prefect of Kaifeng, was made military commissioner of Qin Prefecture; Liu Jixun, commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made military commissioner of Hua Prefecture; Zhang Cong'en, former military commissioner of Yan Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Zhao Ying became Prefect of Kaifeng; the emperor's brother Chongrui left Kaifeng for Qin; Liu Jixun took Hua; and former Yan commissioner Zhang Cong'en took Jin.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，杜威來朝。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Du Wei came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Du Wei presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 定州奏，大風雹，北嶽廟殿宇樹木悉摧拔之。

translations.literal: Ding Prefecture reported that a great wind and hail had utterly uprooted the halls and trees of the Northern Marchmount Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Prefecture reported that wind and hail had destroyed the halls and trees of the Northern Marchmount Temple.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑朔，帝御崇元殿，百官入閣。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the first day yichou, the emperor took the throne at Chongyuan Hall and the hundred officials entered the side hall for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day yichou of the sixth month the emperor held court at Chongyuan Hall and officials entered the side hall.

sentences.zh: 監修國史劉句、史官張昭遠等以新修《唐書》紀、誌、列傳並目錄凡二百三卷上之。

translations.literal: Liu Xu, overseer of the compilation of the national history, Zhang Zhaoyuan, historiographer, and others presented the newly compiled annals, treatises, biographies, and catalogue of the Book of Tang, two hundred and three juan in all.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xu, overseer of the national history, and historiographer Zhang Zhaoyuan and others presented the new Book of Tang—annals, treatises, biographies, and catalogue—in 203 juan.

sentences.zh: 賜器帛有差。

translations.literal: Ritual vessels and silks were bestowed in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards of vessels and silk were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以恒州節度使杜威為天雄軍節度使，充鄴都留守；

translations.literal: On guiyou, Du Wei, military commissioner of Heng Prefecture, was made military commissioner of the Tianxiong Army and appointed garrison commander of the Eastern Capital at Ye;
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Du Wei of Heng became commissioner of the Tianxiong Army and garrison commander of Ye;

sentences.zh: 以鄴都留守馬全節為恒州節度使；

translations.literal: Ma Quanjie, garrison commander of Ye, was made military commissioner of Heng Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Ma Quanjie of Ye became commissioner of Heng;

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、金部郎中、知制誥徐臺符為中書舍人；

translations.literal: Xu Taifu, Hanlin Academician, Director of the Gold Bureau, and drafter of rescripts, was made Secretariat Drafter;
translations.idiomatic: Xu Taifu, Hanlin academician and drafter, became Secretariat Drafter;

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、禮部郎中、知制誥李瀚為中書舍人；

translations.literal: Li Han, Hanlin Academician, Director of the Rites Bureau, and drafter of rescripts, was made Secretariat Drafter;
translations.idiomatic: Li Han, Hanlin academician and drafter, became Secretariat Drafter;

sentences.zh: 翰林學士、都官郎中劉溫叟加知制誥；

translations.literal: Liu Wensou, Hanlin Academician and Director of the Punishments Bureau, was additionally made drafter of rescripts;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wensou, Hanlin academician, was additionally made drafter of rescripts;

sentences.zh: 翰林學士、主客員外郎範質改比部郎中、知制誥，並依舊充職；

translations.literal: Fan Zhi, Hanlin Academician and Vice Director of the Guests Bureau, was changed to Director of the Comparison Bureau and drafter of rescripts, and continued in his former posts;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhi was moved to the Comparison Bureau as drafter while keeping his Hanlin post;

sentences.zh: 祠部員外郎、知制誥張沆本官充學士；

translations.literal: Zhang Hong, Vice Director of the Sacrifices Bureau and drafter of rescripts, was appointed academician in his existing office;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hong, drafter of rescripts, was appointed Hanlin academician in his existing rank;

sentences.zh: 以太常少卿陶穀為中書舍人。

translations.literal: Tao Gu, Vice Director of Ceremonies, was made Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Gu, Vice Director of Ceremonies, became Secretariat Drafter.

sentences.zh: 〈（《宋史·陶穀傳》：穀性急率，嘗與兗帥安審信集會，杯酒相失，為審信所奏，時方姑息武臣，穀坐責授太常少卿。

translations.literal: (Biography of Tao Gu in the Song History: Gu was by nature hasty and blunt; once at a gathering with Yanzhou commander An Shenxin, wine led to a breach, and Shenxin memorialized against him; the court was then indulgent toward military men, and Gu was demoted to Vice Director of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: (Song History, biography of Tao Gu: Gu was brusque and hot-tempered. At a banquet with Yan commander An Shenxin, drink provoked a quarrel and Shenxin denounced him; the court was indulging generals, and Gu was demoted to Vice Director of Ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 嘗上言：「頃蒞西臺，每見臺司詳斷刑獄，少有即時決者。

translations.literal: He once memorialized: "When I recently took charge of the western censorate, I often saw the bureau deliberate on criminal cases, with few decided promptly.
translations.idiomatic: He once wrote: "At the western censorate I saw criminal cases reviewed at length, with few decided on the spot.

sentences.zh: 至於閭閻夫婦，小有爭訟，淹滯即時；

translations.literal: As for common couples in the lanes with minor disputes, delay was immediate;
translations.idiomatic: Yet common couples with petty disputes were delayed immediately;

sentences.zh: 坊市死亡喪葬，必候臺司判狀；

translations.literal: deaths and funerals in wards and markets had to await the bureau's written judgment;
translations.idiomatic: deaths in the wards required the bureau's written ruling before burial;

sentences.zh: 奴婢病亡，亦須檢驗。

translations.literal: when bond servants died of illness, examination was also required.
translations.idiomatic: even sick bond servants had to be examined.

sentences.zh: 吏因緣為奸，而邀求不已，經旬不獲埋瘞。

translations.literal: Clerks used the occasion for corruption and endless demands, so that for ten days burial could not take place.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks extorted bribes so relentlessly that burials were blocked for ten days.

sentences.zh: 望申條約，以革其弊。」

translations.literal: I hope regulations may be issued to reform these abuses."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that rules be issued to end these abuses."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 俄拜中書舍人。）〉

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed Secretariat Drafter.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was made Secretariat Drafter.)〉

sentences.zh: 己亥，以邠州節度使劉景巖為陜州節度使。

translations.literal: On jihai, Liu Jingyan, military commissioner of Bin Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Shaan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Liu Jingyan moved from Bin to Shaan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己卯，新授恒州節度使馬全節卒，輟朝，贈中書令。

translations.literal: On jimao, Ma Quanjie, newly appointed military commissioner of Heng Prefecture, died; court audiences were suspended, and he was posthumously made Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Ma Quanjie, newly appointed to Heng, died; the court suspended audiences and posthumously made him Secretariat Director.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大理卿張仁願卒，贈秘書監。

translations.literal: On renwu, Zhang Renyuan, Director of the Court of Judicial Review, died and was posthumously made Director of the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Zhang Renyuan, Director of Judicial Review, died and was posthumously made Director of the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 遣刑部尚書竇貞固等分詣寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: Dou Zhengu, Minister of Justice, and others were dispatched separately to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Zhengu, Minister of Justice, and others were sent to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以定州節度使王周為恒州節度使，以前易州刺史安審約為定州留後。

translations.literal: On jichou, Wang Zhou, military commissioner of Ding Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Heng Prefecture; An Shenyue, former prefect of Yi Prefecture, was made acting commander of Ding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Wang Zhou took Heng and former Yi prefect An Shenyue became acting commander of Ding.

sentences.zh: 是月，兩京及州郡十五並奏旱。

translations.literal: That month the two capitals and fifteen prefectures all reported drought.
translations.idiomatic: That month the two capitals and fifteen prefectures all reported drought.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙未朔，以侍衛步軍都指揮使、領夔州節度使田武為昭義軍節度使。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the first day yiwei, Tian Wu, commander of the Palace Guards Infantry and concurrent military commissioner of Kui Prefecture, was made military commissioner of the Zhaoyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day yiwei of the seventh autumn month Tian Wu, infantry commander and commissioner of Kui, became commissioner of the Zhaoyi Army.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，左諫議大夫李元龜奏，請禁止天下僧尼典買院舍，從之。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Li Yuan'gui, Left Remonstrance Counselor, memorialized requesting a ban on monks and nuns throughout the realm buying and selling monastic compounds; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Li Yuan'gui asked that monks and nuns be forbidden to buy or sell monastic property empire-wide; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，前少府監李楷貶坊州司戶，坐冒請逃死吏人衣糧入己故也。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Li Kai, former Director of the Palace Workshops, was demoted to Registrar of Fang Prefecture for having fraudulently claimed clothing and grain rations for clerks who had fled or died and kept them for himself.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen former Director of the Palace Workshops Li Kai was demoted to registrar of Fang for embezzling rations of clerks who had fled or died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以前齊州防禦使薛可言為延州兵馬留後。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Xue Keyan, former defense commissioner of Qi Prefecture, was made acting commander of Yan Prefecture forces.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen former Qi defense commissioner Xue Keyan became acting commander of Yan.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day jiazi, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day jiazi of the eighth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人陶穀奏，請權廢太常寺二舞郎。

translations.literal: Tao Gu, Secretariat Drafter, memorialized requesting the provisional abolition of the two dance officers of the Directorate of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat Drafter Tao Gu asked to suspend the two dance officers of the Ceremonies directorate.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，宰臣和凝罷相，守右僕射。

translations.literal: On bingyin, chief minister He Ning was removed as chief counselor and made Defender of the Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin chief minister He Ning left the chief counselor post and became Defender of the Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 以樞密使馮玉為中書侍郎、平章事，使如故。

translations.literal: Feng Yu, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Chief Counselor, continuing in his former commission.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yu, Commissioner of Military Affairs, became Vice Director and Chief Counselor while keeping his commission.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔：「諸御史今後除準式請假外，不得以細故小事請假離京；

translations.literal: On yihai, an edict stated: "Henceforth censors, apart from leave according to standard regulations, may not request leave from the capital for minor trifles;
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an edict declared: "Henceforth censors may leave the capital only on regulated leave, not for petty private reasons;

sentences.zh: 除奉制命差推事及按察外，不得以諸雜細務差出。」

translations.literal: apart from imperial commission to investigate cases and conduct inspections, they may not be dispatched on various miscellaneous minor duties."
translations.idiomatic: and may be sent out only on imperial commission to investigate or inspect, not on miscellaneous errands."

sentences.zh: 丙子，以靈州節度使馮暉為邠州節度使，加檢校太尉；

translations.literal: On bingzi, Feng Hui, military commissioner of Ling Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Bin Prefecture and given acting Grand Marshal;
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Feng Hui moved from Ling to Bin as acting Grand Marshal;

sentences.zh: 以前鄜州節度使丁審琪為左羽林統軍；

translations.literal: Ding Shenqi, former military commissioner of Fu Prefecture, was made commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army;
translations.idiomatic: former Fu commissioner Ding Shenqi became commander of the Left Forest Army;

sentences.zh: 以前鄜州節度使郭謹為左神武統軍。

translations.literal: Guo Jin, former military commissioner of Fu Prefecture, was made commander of the Left Divine Martial Army.
translations.idiomatic: former Fu commissioner Guo Jin became commander of the Left Divine Martial Army.

sentences.zh: 西京留司御史臺奏：「新授鄧州節度使宋彥筠於銀沙灘斬廳頭鄭溫。」

translations.literal: The Western Capital acting censorate reported: "Song Yanyun, newly appointed military commissioner of Deng Prefecture, executed at Yinsha Beach his bureau chief Zheng Wen."
translations.idiomatic: The Western Capital censorate reported: "Song Yanyun, newly appointed to Deng, had executed his bureau chief Zheng Wen at Yinsha Beach."

sentences.zh: 詔鞫之，款云：「彥筠出身軍旅，不知事體，不合專擅行法。」

translations.literal: An edict ordered an inquiry; the confession stated: "Yanyun rose from the military and does not understand proper procedure; he should not have exercised law on his own authority."
translations.idiomatic: An inquiry was ordered; the finding read: "Yanyun is a military man who did not understand that he had no authority to execute judgment on his own."

sentences.zh: 詔釋其罪。

translations.literal: An edict released him from punishment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 以工部尚書王松權知貢舉。

translations.literal: Wang Song, Minister of Works, was made acting overseer of the civil service examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Song, Minister of Works, was made acting chief examiner.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以前晉州節度使安叔千為右金吾上將軍；

translations.literal: On dingchou, An Shuqian, former military commissioner of Jin Prefecture, was made General of the Right Golden Chancellery;
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou former Jin commissioner An Shuqian became General of the Right Golden Chancellery;

sentences.zh: 以三司副使、給事中李穀為磁州刺史，充北面水陸轉運使。

translations.literal: Li Gu, Vice Commissioner of the Three Departments and Supervising Secretary, was made prefect of Ci Prefecture and appointed Northern Circuit land-and-water transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu, vice commissioner of the Three Departments, became prefect of Ci and Northern Circuit transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 分遣使臣於諸道率馬。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched separately to the various circuits to levy horses.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to the circuits to levy horses.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以左金吾上將軍皇甫立為左衛上將軍，以右羽林統軍李懷忠為左武衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Huangfu Li, General of the Left Golden Chancellery, was made General of the Left Guard; Li Huaizhong, commander of the Right Forest of Feathers Army, was made General of the Left Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Huangfu Li became General of the Left Guard and Li Huaizhong of the Right Forest Army became General of the Left Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，新授潞州節度使田武卒，輟朝，贈太尉。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Tian Wu, newly appointed military commissioner of Lu Prefecture, died; court audiences were suspended, and he was posthumously made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Tian Wu, newly appointed to Lu, died; audiences were suspended and he was posthumously made Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 戊子，湖南奏，靜江軍節度使馬希杲卒。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Hunan reported that Ma Xiguo, military commissioner of the Jingjiang Army, had died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Hunan reported the death of Jingjiang commissioner Ma Xiguo.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，以西京留守、北面馬步軍都排陣使景延廣為北面行營副招討使。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingshen, Jing Yanchi, Western Capital garrison commander and Northern Circuit commander for arraying horse and foot armies, was made deputy commander for suppression of the Northern Circuit field headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen of the ninth month Jing Yanchi, Western Capital garrison commander and northern army array commander, became deputy northern campaign commander.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以刑部侍郎趙遠為戶部侍郎，以工部侍郎李式為刑部侍郎，以中書舍人盧價為工部侍郎。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Zhao Yuan, Vice Minister of Justice, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Li Shi, Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Justice; Lu Jia, Secretariat Drafter, was made Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Zhao Yuan moved to Revenue, Li Shi to Justice, and Secretariat Drafter Lu Jia to Works.

sentences.zh: 價久次綸闈，舊例合轉禮部侍郎或御史中丞，宰臣馮玉擬此官，桑維翰以為資望淺，不署狀。

translations.literal: Jia had long served in the drafting office; by old precedent he should have been transferred to Vice Minister of Rites or Censor-in-Chief; chief minister Feng Yu proposed these offices, but Sang Weihan considered his seniority and standing shallow and would not sign the appointment document.
translations.idiomatic: Jia had long served in the drafting office and by precedent should advance to Rites or Censor-in-Chief; Feng Yu proposed those posts, but Sang Weihan deemed him too junior and refused to sign.

sentences.zh: 無何，維翰休沐數日，玉獨奏行之，維翰由是不樂，與玉有間矣。

translations.literal: Before long Sang Weihan was on leave for several days; Yu alone memorialized and carried it through; Weihan was therefore displeased and had a rift with Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Sang took several days' leave; Feng Yu memorialized alone and had the appointment carried through, and Sang's displeasure opened a rift between them.

sentences.zh: 己亥，幸繁臺觀馬，遂幸李守貞第。

translations.literal: On jihai, the emperor visited Fantai to watch horses and then visited the residence of Li Shouzhen.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the emperor watched horses at Fantai and then visited Li Shouzhen's residence.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以晉州節度使張從恩為潞州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Zhang Cong'en, military commissioner of Jin Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Zhang Cong'en moved from Jin to Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎張昭遠加階爵，酬修《唐史》之勞也。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of the Civil Office, was advanced in rank and enfeoffment, rewarding his labor in compiling the Book of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of the Civil Office, received higher rank and fief in reward for compiling the Book of Tang.

sentences.zh: 〈（《宋史·張昭遠傳》：加金紫階，進爵邑。）〉

translations.literal: (Biography of Zhang Zhaoyuan in the Song History: He was given the gold-and-purple rank and advanced in title and fief.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Song History, biography of Zhang Zhaoyuan: He received the gold-and-purple rank and an advance in title and fief.)〉

sentences.zh: 戊申，升曹州為節鎮，以威信軍為軍額。

translations.literal: On wushen, Cao Prefecture was raised to a military prefecture, with Weixin Army as the army designation.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Cao Prefecture was elevated to a military command, taking the army name Weixin.

sentences.zh: 詔李守貞率兵屯澶州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Li Shouzhen to lead troops and encamp at Chan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen was ordered to encamp at Chan with his troops.

sentences.zh: 己酉，月掩昴宿。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the moon occulted the Pleiades mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the moon occulted the Pleiades.

sentences.zh: 以宣徽北院使焦繼勛為宣徽南院使，以內客省使孟承誨為宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: Jiao Jixun, commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made commissioner of the Southern Bureau; Meng Chenghui, commissioner of the Inner Service Directorate, was made commissioner of the Northern Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Jiao Jixun moved from the northern to the southern palace secretariat bureau, and Meng Chenghui from the Inner Service to the northern bureau.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以前太子詹事王居敏為鴻臚卿，李專美為大理卿，以太子賓客致仕馬裔孫為太子詹事。

translations.literal: On renzi, Wang Jumin, former Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Director of the Court of State Ceremonial; Li Zhuanmei was made Director of the Court of Judicial Review; Ma Yisun, retired Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi former Grand Mentor Wang Jumin became Director of State Ceremonial, Li Zhuanmei became Director of Judicial Review, and retired Mentor Ma Yisun became Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，移泰州理所於滿城縣。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the administrative seat of Tai Prefecture was moved to Mancheng County.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the seat of Tai Prefecture was moved to Mancheng County.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔相州節度使張彥澤率兵屯恒州。

translations.literal: On yimao, an edict ordered Zhang Yanze, military commissioner of Xiang Prefecture, to lead troops and encamp at Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Zhang Yanze of Xiang was ordered to encamp at Heng with his troops.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，以河陽節度使何建為涇州節度使，以許州節度使李從溫為河陽節度使，以前鄭州節度使石赟為曹州節度使。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on wuyin, He Jian, military commissioner of Heyang, was made military commissioner of Jing Prefecture; Li Congwen, military commissioner of Xu Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Heyang; Shi Yun, former military commissioner of Zheng Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Cao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the tenth winter month He Jian moved from Heyang to Jing, Li Congwen from Xu to Heyang, and former Zheng commissioner Shi Yun to Cao.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣使太子賓客羅周嶽、使副太子右庶子王延濟冊兩浙節度使錢宏佐為守太尉。

translations.literal: On gengwu, envoys were dispatched: chief envoy Luo Zhouyue, Mentor of the Heir Apparent, and deputy envoy Wang Yanji, Right Vice Mentor of the Heir Apparent, to invest Qian Hongzuo, military commissioner of the Two Zhes, as Defender of Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu chief envoy Luo Zhouyue and deputy Wang Yanji were sent to invest Two-Zhe commissioner Qian Hongzuo as Defender of Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 辛未，右金吾衛上將軍楊彥詢卒，贈太子太師。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Yang Yanxun, General of the Right Golden Chancellery Guard, died and was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Yang Yanxun, General of the Right Golden Chancellery Guard, died and was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，高麗遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Goryeo dispatched envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Goryeo sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以前延州節度使王令溫為靈州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Wang Lingwen, former military commissioner of Yan Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Ling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen former Yan commissioner Wang Lingwen became commissioner of Ling.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以邢州兵馬留後劉在明為晉州兵馬留後，以前河陽留後方太為邢州留後。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Liu Zaiming, acting commander of Xing Prefecture forces, was made acting commander of Jin Prefecture forces; Fang Tai, former acting commander of Heyang, was made acting commander of Xing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Liu Zaiming moved from acting Xing to acting Jin command, and former Heyang acting commander Fang Tai to Xing.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，升陳州為節鎮，以鎮安軍為軍額。

translations.literal: On guisi, Chen Prefecture was raised to a military prefecture, with Zhen'an Army as the army designation.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Chen Prefecture was elevated to a military command, taking the army name Zhen'an.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，以邠州節度使馮暉兼侍衛步軍都指揮使，充北面行營先鋒馬步軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuxu, Feng Hui, military commissioner of Bin Prefecture, was made concurrent commander of the Palace Guards Infantry and appointed commander of horse and foot for the vanguard of the Northern Circuit field headquarters;
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu of the eleventh month Feng Hui of Bin was made infantry commander and vanguard commander of the northern field army;

sentences.zh: 以權知高麗國事王武為檢校太保、使持節、玄菟州都督，充大義軍使，封高麗國王。

translations.literal: Wang Wu, acting overseer of Goryeo affairs, was made acting Grand Guardian, commissioner bearing the staff of office, and Governor-General of Xuantu Prefecture, appointed commissioner of the Dayi Army, and enfeoffed as King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wu, acting overseer of Goryeo, was made acting Grand Guardian and commissioner, governor-general of Xuantu, commissioner of the Dayi Army, and enfeoffed King of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，日南至，帝御崇元殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: On guimao, the winter solstice, the emperor took the throne at Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the winter solstice, the emperor received congratulations at Chongyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊申，兩浙奏，順化軍節度使錢鐸卒。

translations.literal: On wushen, the Two Zhes reported that Qian Duo, military commissioner of the Shunhua Army, had died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Two Zhes reported the death of Shunhua commissioner Qian Duo.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以壽州節度使、侍衛馬軍都指揮使李彥韜為陳州節度使，典軍如故。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Li Yantao, military commissioner of Shou Prefecture and commander of the Palace Guards Cavalry, was made military commissioner of Chen Prefecture, continuing to command troops as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Li Yantao of Shou became commissioner of Chen while retaining cavalry command.

sentences.zh: 丙申，前商州刺史李俊除名，坐受財枉法也。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Li Jun, former prefect of Shang Prefecture, was stripped of his name register for having taken bribes and perverted the law.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen former Shang prefect Li Jun was struck from the register for bribery and corruption.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，以兩浙節度使、吳越國王錢宏佐兼東南面兵馬都元帥。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yichou, Qian Hongzuo, military commissioner of the Two Zhes and King of Wuyue, was made concurrent commander-in-chief of southeastern armies and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the twelfth month Two-Zhe commissioner and Wuyue king Qian Hongzuo was made concurrent southeastern commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以吳越國金馬左廂都指揮使、湖州刺史胡思進遙領虔州昭信軍節度使，以吳越國金馬右廂都指揮使、明州刺史闞璠遙領宣州寧國軍節度使，並典軍如故。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Hu Sijin, commander of the Left Golden Horse Wing of Wuyue and prefect of Hu Prefecture, was given concurrent remote command of the Zhaoxin Army at Qian Prefecture; Kan Fan, commander of the Right Golden Horse Wing and prefect of Ming Prefecture, was given concurrent remote command of the Ningguo Army at Xuan Prefecture; both continued to command troops as before.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Hu Sijin of Wuyue held Qian remotely and Kan Fan held Xuan remotely, each keeping his original command.

sentences.zh: 左羽林統軍丁審琪卒，贈太尉。

translations.literal: Ding Shenqi, commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army, died and was posthumously made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Shenqi, commander of the Left Forest Army, died and was posthumously made Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以工部侍郎盧價為禮部侍郎，以右散騎常侍、集賢殿學士、判院事司徒詡為工部侍郎，依前充職；

translations.literal: On xinwei, Lu Jia, Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Rites; Situ Xu, Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and overseer of the academy, was made Vice Minister of Works, continuing in his former posts;
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Lu Jia moved to Rites and Situ Xu to Works while keeping his academy posts;

sentences.zh: 以前中書舍人殷鵬為給事中，充樞密直學士；

translations.literal: Yin Peng, former Secretariat Drafter, was made Supervising Secretary and appointed direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: former Secretariat Drafter Yin Peng became Supervising Secretary and direct academician of Military Affairs;

sentences.zh: 以給事中劉知新為右散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Liu Zhixin, Supervising Secretary, was made Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhixin, Supervising Secretary, became Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，陜府節度使劉景巖來朝。

translations.literal: On yihai, Liu Jingyan, military commissioner of the Shaan prefecture circuit, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Shaan commissioner Liu Jingyan presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，狩於近郊，獵也。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the emperor hunted in the near suburbs—a hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the emperor hunted in the suburbs.

sentences.zh: 己卯，光祿卿致仕陳元卒於太原。

translations.literal: On jimao, Chen Yuan, retired Director of the Imperial Household, died at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao retired Director of the Imperial Household Chen Yuan died at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命使冊高麗國王王武。

translations.literal: On gengchen, envoys were ordered to invest Wang Wu as King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen envoys were sent to invest Wang Wu as King of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以前兗州節度使安審信為華州節度使。

translations.literal: On guiwei, An Shenxin, former military commissioner of Yan Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei former Yan commissioner An Shenxin became commissioner of Hua.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以樞密使、中書令桑維翰為開封尹；

translations.literal: On dinghai, Sang Weihan, Commissioner of Military Affairs and Secretariat Director, was made Prefect of Kaifeng;
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Sang Weihan, Commissioner of Military Affairs and Secretariat Director, became Prefect of Kaifeng;

sentences.zh: 以司空、門下侍郎、平章事劉句判三司；

translations.literal: Liu Xu, Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Chief Counselor, was made overseer of the Three Departments;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xu, Minister of Works and Chief Counselor, was made overseer of the Three Departments;

sentences.zh: 以左僕射、門下侍郎、平章事李崧為守侍中，充樞密使；

translations.literal: Li Song, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Chief Counselor, was made Defender of Palace Attendant and appointed Commissioner of Military Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Li Song, Left Vice Director and Chief Counselor, became Defender of Palace Attendant and Commissioner of Military Affairs;

sentences.zh: 以開封尹趙瑩為中書令、宏文館大學士；

translations.literal: Zhao Ying, Prefect of Kaifeng, was made Secretariat Director and Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ying, Prefect of Kaifeng, became Secretariat Director and Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall;

sentences.zh: 以宣徽南院使焦繼勛知陜州軍州事。

translations.literal: Jiao Jixun, commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made overseer of Shaan Prefecture military and civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Jiao Jixun, southern palace secretariat commissioner, was made overseer of Shaan.

sentences.zh: 〈（《宋史·焦繼勛傳》：西人寇邊，朝議發師致討，繼勛抗疏請行，拜秦州觀察使兼諸蕃水陸轉運使。

translations.literal: (Biography of Jiao Jixun in the Song History: When western peoples raided the border, the court debated sending troops to punish them; Jixun submitted a forthright memorial requesting to go and was appointed observation commissioner of Qin Prefecture and concurrent land-and-water transport commissioner for the various tribes.
translations.idiomatic: (Song History, biography of Jiao Jixun: When western tribes raided the frontier, the court debated punitive troops; Jixun memorialized to lead them and was made Qin observation commissioner and frontier transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 既至，推恩信，設方略，招誘諸部，相率奉玉帛牛酒乞盟，邊境以安。

translations.literal: Once he arrived, he extended favor and trust, devised strategy, and enticed the various tribes; they came forward in succession offering jade, silks, cattle, and wine to seek alliance, and the border was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he won trust, devised strategy, and drew the tribes in; they came offering tribute and seeking peace, and the border was secured.

sentences.zh: 俄徙知陜州。）〉

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was transferred to oversee Shaan Prefecture.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was transferred to Shaan.)〉

sentences.zh: 己丑，邠州節度使馮暉準詔來朝。

translations.literal: On jichou, Feng Hui, military commissioner of Bin Prefecture, came to court by imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Bin commissioner Feng Hui came to court as ordered.

sentences.zh: 是歲，帝每遇四方進獻器皿，多以銀於外府易金而入，謂左右曰：「金者貴而且輕，便於人力。」

translations.literal: That year, whenever the emperor received vessels presented from the four quarters, he often exchanged silver at outer treasuries for gold to bring in, saying to those around him: "Gold is precious yet light, convenient for human labor."
translations.idiomatic: That year, whenever tribute vessels arrived from the provinces, the emperor often traded silver at outer treasuries for gold, telling his attendants: "Gold is precious yet light—easier for people to carry."

sentences.zh: 識者以為北遷之兆也。

translations.literal: Those with insight took this as an omen of removal to the north.
translations.idiomatic: Observers took this as an omen of flight to the north.

sentences.zh: 〈（《宋史·劉濤傳》：少帝奢侈，常以銀易金，廣其器皿。

translations.literal: (Biography of Liu Tao in the Song History: Emperor Shao was extravagant and often exchanged silver for gold to enlarge his vessels.
translations.idiomatic: (Song History, biography of Liu Tao: Emperor Shao was extravagant and often traded silver for gold to enlarge his vessels.

sentences.zh: 李崧判三司，令上庫金之數。

translations.literal: Li Song, overseer of the Three Departments, ordered a count of gold in the upper treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Li Song, overseer of the Three Departments, ordered a count of gold in the upper treasury.

sentences.zh: 及崧以原簿校之，少數千鎰。

translations.literal: When Song checked against the original ledger, several thousand ingots were short.
translations.idiomatic: Checked against the ledger, several thousand ingots were missing.

sentences.zh: 崧責曰：「帑庫通式，一日不受虛數，毫厘則有重典。」

translations.literal: Song rebuked him: "Treasury regulations do not accept false figures for a single day; the slightest discrepancy brings severe punishment."
translations.idiomatic: Song rebuked him: "Treasury rules forbid false accounts even for a day; the slightest shortfall brings severe punishment."

sentences.zh: 濤曰：「帑司常有報不盡數，以備宣索。」

translations.literal: Tao said: "The treasury office often reports less than the full amount to reserve for imperial requisitions."
translations.idiomatic: Tao replied: "Treasury officials often under-report to reserve for imperial demands."

sentences.zh: 崧令有司劾濤，濤事迫，以情告樞密使桑維翰，乃止罰一月俸。）〉

translations.literal: Song had the authorities impeach Tao; pressed by the case, Tao confided the facts to Commissioner of Military Affairs Sang Weihan, and the penalty was reduced to one month's salary.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Song had Tao impeached; Tao appealed to Sang Weihan, and the penalty was reduced to one month's salary.)〉

sentences.zh: 開運三年春正月癸巳朔，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kaiyun, spring, the first month, on the first day guisi, the emperor took the throne at Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations, with guards and insignia according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day guisi of the first month of Kaiyun 3 the emperor received New Year congratulations at Chongyuan Hall with full ceremonial guard.

sentences.zh: 詔改鑄天下合同印、書詔印、御前印，並以黃金為之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered recasting throughout the realm the contract seal, rescript seal, and imperial presence seal, all to be made of gold.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the empire's contract, rescript, and imperial presence seals recast in gold.

sentences.zh: 己亥，貝州梁漢璋奏，蕃寇屯聚，將謀入寇。

translations.literal: On jihai, Liang Hanzhang of Bei Prefecture reported that barbarian raiders were massing and planning an invasion.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Liang Hanzhang of Bei reported barbarian forces massing for invasion.

sentences.zh: 詔符彥卿屯荊州口。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Fu Yanqing to encamp at Jingzhou Ford.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yanqing was ordered to encamp at Jingzhou Ford.

sentences.zh: 〈（《宋史·符彥卿傳》：再出河朔，彥卿不與，易其行伍，配以羸師數千戍荊州口。）〉

translations.literal: (Biography of Fu Yanqing in the Song History: When troops were again sent to the Hebei region, Yanqing would not go; his unit was changed and he was assigned several thousand weak troops to garrison Jingzhou Ford.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Song History, biography of Fu Yanqing: When troops were again sent north, Yanqing refused; his command was changed and he was given a few thousand weak troops to garrison Jingzhou Ford.)〉

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以前華州節度使劉繼勛為同州節度使，以陜州節度使劉景巖為鄧州節度使。

translations.literal: On guimao, Liu Jixun, former military commissioner of Hua Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Tong Prefecture; Liu Jingyan, military commissioner of Shaan Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Liu Jixun moved from Hua to Tong and Liu Jingyan from Shaan to Deng.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以宣徽南院使、知陜州事焦繼勛為陜州留後。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Jiao Jixun, commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and overseer of Shaan affairs, was made acting commander of Shaan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Jiao Jixun became acting commander of Shaan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，刑部員外王洧賜自家自盡，坐私用宮錢經營求利故也。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Wang Wei, Vice Director of the Justice Bureau, was granted permission to take his own life at home for having used palace funds privately to seek profit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Wang Wei of the Justice Bureau was allowed to kill himself at home for embezzling palace funds for private profit.

sentences.zh: 右司郎中李知損貶均州司戶，員外置，馳驛發遣，坐前任度支判官日與解縣榷鹽使王景遇交遊借貸故也。

translations.literal: Li Zhisun, Director of the Right Bureau, was demoted to Registrar of Jun Prefecture, an extra appointment, and dispatched by post horse for having, while previously serving as revenue adjudicator, socialized and borrowed money from Wang Jingyu, salt monopoly commissioner of Jie County.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhisun was demoted to registrar of Jun and sent off by courier for borrowing from salt commissioner Wang Jingyu while a revenue adjudicator.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔侍衛親軍副都指揮使李守貞率師巡撫北邊。

translations.literal: On jiyou, an edict ordered Li Shouzhen, deputy commander of the Palace Guards Personal Army, to lead troops on a pacification tour of the northern border.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Li Shouzhen, deputy commander of the palace guard, was ordered to pacify the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以皇弟秦州節度使重睿為許州節度使，以許州節度使安審琦為兗州節度使，以兗州節度使趙在禮為晉昌軍節度使。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the emperor's younger brother Chongrui, military commissioner of Qin Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Xu Prefecture; An Shenqi, military commissioner of Xu Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Yan Prefecture; Zhao Zaili, military commissioner of Yan Prefecture, was made military commissioner of the Jinchang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the emperor's brother Chongrui took Xu, An Shenqi took Yan, and Zhao Zaili took the Jinchang Army.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以涇州節度使何建為秦州節度使，以前貝州節度使史威為涇州節度使。

translations.literal: On guichou, He Jian, military commissioner of Jing Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Qin Prefecture; Shi Wei, former military commissioner of Bei Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou He Jian moved from Jing to Qin and former Bei commissioner Shi Wei to Jing.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，定州奏，契丹入寇。

translations.literal: On yimao, Ding Prefecture reported that the Khitan had invaded.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Ding Prefecture reported a Khitan invasion.

sentences.zh: 己未，二王後守太僕少卿、襲酅國公楊延壽除名配流威州，終身勿齒。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Yang Yanshou, Defender of the Vice Director of the Imperial Stud for heirs of the two former dynasties and inheritor Duke of Xi, was struck from the register and exiled to Wei Prefecture, never to be ranked among officials again.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Yang Yanshou, heir Duke of Xi, was struck from the register, exiled to Wei, and barred from office for life.

sentences.zh: 延壽奉命於磁州檢苗，受贓二百餘匹，準律當絞，有司以二王後入議，故貸其死。

translations.literal: Yanshou, on orders at Ci Prefecture to inspect the grain tax, had taken more than two hundred bolts in bribes; by law he deserved strangulation, but the authorities debated his status as heir of the two dynasties and therefore spared his life.
translations.idiomatic: Inspecting the grain tax at Ci, he had taken over two hundred bolts in bribes—a capital crime—but because he was heir of the two dynasties his life was spared.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the first day renxu, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day renxu of the second month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 詔滑州皇甫遇率兵援糧入易、定等州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Huangfu Yu of Hua Prefecture to lead troops escorting grain into Yi, Ding, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Huangfu Yu of Hua to lead troops escorting grain into Yi, Ding, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以滄州留後王景為本州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Wang Jing, acting commander of Cang Prefecture, was made military commissioner of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Wang Jing, Cang acting commander, became military commissioner of Cang.

sentences.zh: 右僕射和凝逐月別給錢五萬、傔糧芻粟等，優舊相也。

translations.literal: He Ning, Right Vice Director, was separately given fifty thousand strings of cash each month along with attendant provisions of grain and fodder—a favor to a former chief counselor.
translations.idiomatic: Right Vice Director He Ning was granted fifty thousand cash monthly plus attendant grain and fodder—a favor to a former chief counselor.

sentences.zh: 辛未，魯國大長公主史氏薨，輟朝三日。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Grand Princess of Lu of the Shi clan died; court audiences were suspended for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Grand Princess of Lu of the Shi clan died; court was suspended for three days.

sentences.zh: 丙子，光祿卿致仕王宏贄卒，贈太常卿。

translations.literal: On bingzi, retired Director of the Imperial Household Wang Hongzan died; he was posthumously made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi retired Director of the Imperial Household Wang Hongzan died and was posthumously made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 回鶻遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: The Uyghurs sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The Uyghurs sent tribute envoys with local products.

sentences.zh: 升桂州全義縣為溥州，仍隸桂州，其全義縣改為德昌縣，從湖南馬希範所請也。

translations.literal: Quanyi County of Gui Prefecture was elevated to Pu Prefecture while remaining subordinate to Gui; Quanyi County was changed to Dechang County, pursuant to the request of Ma Xifan of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Quanyi County of Gui was elevated to Pu Prefecture, still subordinate to Gui; Quanyi was renamed Dechang County at the request of Ma Xifan of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以前晉昌軍節度使安彥威充北面行營副都統，以宣徽北院使兼太府卿孟承誨為右武衛大將軍充職；

translations.literal: On renwu, An Yanwei, former military commissioner of the Jinchang Army, was appointed deputy overall commander of the Northern Circuit field headquarters; Meng Chenghui, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and Concurrent Director of the Imperial Treasury, was made General of the Right Martial Guard while retaining his commission;
translations.idiomatic: On renwu former Jinchang commissioner An Yanwei became deputy northern commander, and Northern Bureau Commissioner and Concurrent Director of the Imperial Treasury Meng Chenghui became General of the Right Martial Guard while retaining his post;

sentences.zh: 是日幸南莊，命臣僚泛舟飲酒，因幸杜威園，醉方歸內。

translations.literal: That day the emperor visited the Southern Estate, ordered officials to banquet on boats, and also visited Du Wei's garden; only when drunk did he return to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: That day he visited the Southern Estate and ordered officials boating and drinking; he also visited Du Wei's garden and returned to the palace drunk.

sentences.zh: 甲申，河陽節度使李從溫薨，輟朝，贈太師。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Li Congwen, military commissioner of Heyang, died; court audiences were suspended, and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Heyang commissioner Li Congwen died; audiences were suspended and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰朔，以權知河西節度使張遵古為河西留後。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day renchen, Zhang Zungu, acting military commissioner of Hexi, was made acting commander of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day renchen of the third month Zhang Zungu became acting commander of Hexi.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以御史中丞顏衎為戶部侍郎，以戶部侍郎趙遠為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Yan Kan, Censor-in-Chief, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Zhao Yuan, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Yan Kan became Vice Minister of Revenue and Zhao Yuan Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以邠州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使馮暉為河陽節度使，以前涇州節度使李德充為邠州節度使。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Feng Hui, military commissioner of Bin Prefecture and commander of the Palace Guards Infantry, was made military commissioner of Heyang; Li Dechong, former military commissioner of Jing Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Feng Hui of Bin took Heyang and former Jing commissioner Li Dechong took Bin.

sentences.zh: 李守貞奏，大軍至衡水。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen reported that the main army had reached Hengshui.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen reported the main army had reached Hengshui.

sentences.zh: 己亥，奏獲鄭州刺史趙思恭。

translations.literal: On jihai, he reported the capture of Zhao Sigong, prefect of Zheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he reported capturing Zheng prefect Zhao Sigong.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，奏大軍回至冀州。

translations.literal: On guimao, he reported that the main army had returned to Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he reported the main army had returned to Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戶部侍郎顏衎上表，以母老乞解官就養。

translations.literal: Yan Kan, Vice Minister of Revenue, submitted a memorial requesting to resign his office and care for his aged mother.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Yan Kan asked to resign to care for his aged mother.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以皇子齊州防禦使延煦為澶州節度使。

translations.literal: On wushen, the prince Yanshu, defense commissioner of Qi Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Chan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Prince Yanshu of Qi became commissioner of Chan.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，密州上言，饑民殍者一千五百。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Mi Prefecture reported that fifteen hundred starving people had died in the streets.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Mi Prefecture reported fifteen hundred starvation deaths.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以瓜州刺史曹元忠為沙州留後。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Cao Yuanzhong, prefect of Gua Prefecture, was made acting commander of Sha Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Gua prefect Cao Yuanzhong became acting commander of Sha.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉朔，李守貞自北班師到闕。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the first day xinyou, Li Shouzhen returned from the north with his army to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day xinyou of the fourth summer month Li Shouzhen returned from the north to court.

sentences.zh: 太原奏，吐渾白可久奔歸契丹，諸侯咸有異志。

translations.literal: Taiyuan reported that the Tuyuhun leader Bai Kejiu had fled to the Khitan, and the various lords all harbored divergent intentions.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan reported that Tuyuhun leader Bai Kejiu had defected to the Khitan and that regional lords were wavering.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宰臣詣寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: On yihai, the chief ministers went to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai chief ministers prayed for rain at temples and monasteries.

sentences.zh: 曹州奏，部民相次饑死凡三千人。

translations.literal: Cao Prefecture reported that among its people three thousand had died of hunger in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Prefecture reported three thousand successive starvation deaths.

sentences.zh: 時河南、河北大饑，殍名甚眾，沂、密、兗、鄆寇盜群起，所在屯聚，剽劫縣邑，吏不能禁。

translations.literal: At that time Henan and Hebei suffered great famine; the dead in the streets were very numerous; in Yi, Mi, Yan, and Yun bandits rose in groups, gathering everywhere, plundering counties and towns, and officials could not suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Henan and Hebei were in famine; corpses littered the roads; bandits rose in Yi, Mi, Yan, and Yun, raiding towns officials could not control.

sentences.zh: 兗州節度使安審琦出兵捕逐，為賊所敗。

translations.literal: An Shenqi, military commissioner of Yan Prefecture, led troops to pursue and capture them but was defeated by the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Yan commissioner An Shenqi led troops against them but was defeated.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸相國寺禱雨。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the emperor visited Xiangguo Temple to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the emperor prayed for rain at Xiangguo Temple.

sentences.zh: 皇子延煦與晉昌軍節度使趙在禮結婚，命宗正卿石光贊主之。

translations.literal: The prince Yanshu married the daughter of Zhao Zaili, military commissioner of the Jinchang Army; Director of the Imperial Clan Shi Guangzan was ordered to preside.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yanshu married Zhao Zaili's daughter of the Jinchang Army; Imperial Clan Director Shi Guangzan presided.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅朔，以兵部郎中劉皞為太府卿。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the first day gengyin, Liu Hao, Director of the War Bureau, was made Director of the Imperial Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day gengyin of the fifth month Liu Hao became Director of the Imperial Treasury.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以前同州節度使馮道為鄧州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Feng Dao, former military commissioner of Tong Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu former Tong commissioner Feng Dao became commissioner of Deng.

sentences.zh: 定州奏，部民相次擄殺流移，約五千餘戶。

translations.literal: Ding Prefecture reported that among its people, in succession, those abducted and killed or displaced amounted to about five thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Prefecture reported some five thousand households killed, abducted, or displaced in succession.

sentences.zh: 青州奏，全家殍死者一百一十二戶。

translations.literal: Qing Prefecture reported one hundred twelve households in which the entire family had died in the streets.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Prefecture reported one hundred twelve households wiped out by starvation.

sentences.zh: 沂州奏，淮南遣海州刺史領兵一千五百人，應接賊頭常知及。

translations.literal: Yi Prefecture reported that Huainan had sent the prefect of Hai Prefecture leading fifteen hundred troops to support the bandit chief Chang Zhiqi.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Prefecture reported Huainan had sent Hai prefect with fifteen hundred men to aid bandit chief Chang Zhiqi.

sentences.zh: 詔兗州安審琦領兵捕逐。

translations.literal: An edict ordered An Shenqi of Yan Prefecture to lead troops to pursue and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: An Shenqi of Yan was ordered to pursue the bandits.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以前太子賓客韋勛為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Wei Xun, former Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen former Mentor Wei Xun was reappointed Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 兗州安審琦奏，淮賊抽退，賊頭常知及與相次首領武約等並乞歸命。

translations.literal: An Shenqi of Yan Prefecture reported that the Huainan bandits had withdrawn, and the bandit chief Chang Zhiqi and successive leaders such as Wu Yue all sought to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: An Shenqi reported the Huainan raiders had withdrawn and Chang Zhiqi, Wu Yue, and other leaders sought to surrender.

sentences.zh: 丁未，幸大年莊，遊船習射。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the emperor visited Danian Estate and practiced archery from boats.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the emperor visited Danian Estate and practiced archery from boats.

sentences.zh: 帝醉甚，賜群官器帛過差，夜分方歸內。

translations.literal: The emperor was very drunk, bestowed vessels and silks on the officials in excessive measure, and did not return within until midnight.
translations.idiomatic: Deeply drunk, he gave officials excessive gifts of vessels and silk and did not return to the palace until midnight.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以鄜州留後李殷為定州節度使。

translations.literal: On wushen, Li Yin, acting commander of Fu Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Ding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen former Fu acting commander Li Yin became commissioner of Ding.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔皇甫遇為北面行營都部署，張彥澤為副，李殷為都監，領兵赴易、定等州，尋止其行。

translations.literal: On xinhai, an edict made Huangfu Yu overall commander of the Northern Circuit field headquarters, Zhang Yanze deputy, and Li Yin chief overseer, to lead troops to Yi, Ding, and other prefectures; soon afterward their march was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Huangfu Yu was made northern commander, Zhang Yanze deputy, and Li Yin overseer, to march on Yi and Ding—but the order was soon countermanded.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以貝州留後梁漢璋為貝州節度使，以左神武統軍郭謹為鄜州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Liang Hanzhang, acting commander of Bei Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Bei Prefecture; Guo Jin, commander of the Left Divine Martial Army, was made military commissioner of Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Liang Hanzhang became Bei commissioner and Guo Jin of the Left Divine Martial Army became Fu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申朔，登州奏，文登縣部內有銅佛像四、瓷佛像十，自地踴出。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the first day gengshen, Deng Prefecture reported that within Wendeng County four bronze Buddha images and ten porcelain Buddha images had sprung forth from the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day gengshen of the sixth month Deng reported four bronze and ten porcelain Buddha images emerging from the ground in Wendeng County.

sentences.zh: 狼山招收指揮使孫方簡叛，據狼山歸契丹。

translations.literal: Sun Fangjian, recruitment commander of Lang Mountain, rebelled, seized Lang Mountain, and submitted to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Lang Mountain recruitment commander Sun Fangjian rebelled, seized the mountain, and defected to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔諸道不得橫薦官僚，如本處幕府有闕，即得奏薦。

translations.literal: On yichou, an edict stated that the various circuits might not recommend officials indiscriminately; if a post was vacant in the local staff, then they might memorialize a recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou circuits were forbidden to recommend officials indiscriminately; they might recommend only to fill vacancies in their own staffs.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以前昭義軍節度使李從敏為河陽節度使，以河陽節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使馮暉為靈州節度使。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Li Congmin, former military commissioner of the Zhaoyi Army, was made military commissioner of Heyang; Feng Hui, military commissioner of Heyang and commander of the Palace Guards Infantry, was made military commissioner of Ling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Li Congmin took Heyang and Feng Hui of Heyang took Ling.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以鄆州節度使兼侍衛親軍都指揮使高行周為宋州節度使，加兼中書令，充北面行營副都統；

translations.literal: On renwu, Gao Xingzhou, military commissioner of Yan Prefecture and commander of the Palace Guards Personal Army, was made military commissioner of Song Prefecture, additionally made Concurrent Secretariat Director, and appointed deputy overall commander of the Northern Circuit field headquarters;
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Gao Xingzhou of Yan became Song commissioner, Concurrent Secretariat Director, and deputy northern commander;

sentences.zh: 以宋州節度使、侍衛親軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: The military commissioner of Song Prefecture, commander of the Palace Guards Personal Army—
translations.idiomatic: The Song Prefecture military commissioner and palace guard commander—

sentences.zh: 〈（案：以下有闕文。）〉

translations.literal: (Note: text is missing below.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Note: the text below is missing.)〉

sentences.zh: 定州奏，蕃寇壓境。

translations.literal: Ding Prefecture reported that barbarian raiders were pressing the border.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Prefecture reported barbarian forces pressing the border.

sentences.zh: 詔李守貞為北面行營都部署，滑州皇甫遇為副，相州張彥澤充馬軍都指揮使，定州李殷充步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: An edict made Li Shouzhen overall commander of the Northern Circuit field headquarters, Huangfu Yu of Hua Prefecture deputy, Zhang Yanze of Xiang Prefecture commander of the cavalry, and Li Yin of Ding Prefecture commander of the infantry.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen was made northern commander, Huangfu Yu of Hua deputy, Zhang Yanze of Xiang cavalry commander, and Li Yin of Ding infantry commander.

sentences.zh: 七月壬辰，以禮部尚書王延為刑部尚書，以工部尚書王松為禮部尚書，以太常卿龍敏為工部尚書，以左丞李慎儀為太常卿，以吏部侍郎張昭遠為左丞，以右丞李詳為吏部侍郎，以前義州刺史李玘為右丞。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on renchen, Wang Yan, Minister of Rites, was made Minister of Justice; Wang Song, Minister of Works, was made Minister of Rites; Long Min, Director of Ceremonies, was made Minister of Works; Li Shenyi, Left Vice Director, was made Director of Ceremonies; Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of the Civil Office, was made Left Vice Director; Li Xiang, Right Vice Director, was made Vice Minister of the Civil Office; Li Qi, former prefect of Yi Prefecture, was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen of the seventh month Wang Yan moved to Justice, Wang Song to Rites, Long Min to Works, Li Shenyi to Ceremonies, Zhang Zhaoyuan to Left Vice Director, Li Xiang to Civil Vice Minister, and former Yi prefect Li Qi to Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 前晉昌軍節度使安彥威薨，輟朝，贈太師。

translations.literal: An Yanwei, former military commissioner of the Jinchang Army, died; court audiences were suspended, and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Former Jinchang commissioner An Yanwei died; audiences were suspended and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丙申，兩浙節度使、吳越國王錢宏佐加守太師，北京留守、河東節度使、北平王劉知遠加守太尉。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Qian Hongzuo, military commissioner of the Two Zhes and King of Wuyue, was made Defender of Grand Preceptor; Liu Zhiyuan, garrison commander of the Northern Capital, military commissioner of Hedong, and Prince of Beiping, was made Defender of Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Qian Hongzuo of Wuyue became Defender of Grand Preceptor and Liu Zhiyuan of Hedong Defender of Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 滄州奏，蕃寇攻饒安縣。

translations.literal: Cang Prefecture reported that barbarian raiders were attacking Rao'an County.
translations.idiomatic: Cang Prefecture reported barbarian forces attacking Rao'an County.

sentences.zh: 楊劉口河決西岸，水闊四十里。

translations.literal: The Yangliu Ford on the Yellow River burst its west bank; the water spread forty li wide.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River burst its west bank at Yangliu Ford; the flood spread forty li wide.

sentences.zh: 以前鄧州節度使劉景巖為太子太師致仕。

translations.literal: Liu Jingyan, former military commissioner of Deng Prefecture, was made retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Former Deng commissioner Liu Jingyan was retired as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，宋州谷熟縣河水雨水一概東流，漂沒秋稼。

translations.literal: On xinhai, in Gushu County of Song Prefecture, river water and rainwater alike flowed eastward and swept away the autumn grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai river and rain at Gushu in Song flowed east together and destroyed the autumn crop.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，大理卿李專美卒。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Li Zhuanmei, Director of the Court of Judicial Review, died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Zhuanmei, Director of Judicial Review, died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔偽清泰朝經削奪官爵朱宏昭、馮赟、康義誠、王思同、藥彥稠等，並復其官爵。

translations.literal: On wuwu, an edict restored the ranks and titles of Zhu Hongzhao, Feng Yun, Kang Yicheng, Wang Sitong, Yao Yanchou, and others, who under the false Qingtai reign had been stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu an edict restored the ranks of Zhu Hongzhao, Feng Yun, Kang Yicheng, Wang Sitong, Yao Yanchou, and others stripped under the Qingtai reign.

sentences.zh: 自夏初至是，河南、河北諸州郡餓死者數萬人，群盜蜂起，剽略縣鎮，霖雨不止，川澤泛漲，損害秋稼。

translations.literal: From early summer until now, in the prefectures of Henan and Hebei tens of thousands died of hunger; bandits swarmed like bees, plundering counties and towns; unending rains made rivers and marshes overflow and harmed the autumn grain.
translations.idiomatic: Since early summer Henan and Hebei had seen tens of thousands starve, bandits raid towns, endless rain flood the rivers, and the autumn crop ruined.

sentences.zh: 八月己未朔，以左諫議大夫裴羽為給事中。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day jiwei, Pei Yu, Left Remonstrance Counselor, was made Supervising Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day jiwei of the eighth month Pei Yu became Supervising Secretary.

sentences.zh: 庚申，李守貞、皇甫遇駐軍定州。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Li Shouzhen and Huangfu Yu encamped their armies at Ding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Li Shouzhen and Huangfu Yu encamped at Ding.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，幸南莊，召從臣宴樂，至暮還宮。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the emperor visited the Southern Estate, summoned attending officials for feasting and music, and returned to the palace at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the emperor feasted officials at the Southern Estate and returned at dusk.

sentences.zh: 詔潞州運糧十三萬赴恒州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered one hundred thirty thousand piculs of grain transported from Lu Prefecture to Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered 130,000 piculs of grain sent from Lu to Heng.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以右散騎常侍張煦為青州刺史。

translations.literal: On guihai, Zhang Xu, Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made prefect of Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zhang Xu became prefect of Qing.

sentences.zh: 李守貞奏，大軍至望都縣，相次至長城北，遇敵千餘騎，轉鬥四十里，斬蕃將解裏相公。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen reported that the main army reached Wangdu County and in succession reached the Long Wall north, encountered more than a thousand enemy horsemen, fought for forty li, and beheaded the barbarian general known as the Xianggong of Jieli.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen reported reaching Wangdu and the northern Long Wall, fighting a thousand enemy horsemen for forty li and beheading the barbarian general Jieli Xianggong.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔班師。

translations.literal: On dingmao, an edict ordered withdrawal of the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the army was ordered to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以前亳州防禦使邊蔚為戶部侍郎；

translations.literal: On gengwu, Bian Wei, former defense commissioner of Bo Prefecture, was made Vice Minister of Revenue;
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu former Bo defense commissioner Bian Wei became Vice Minister of Revenue;

sentences.zh: 以刑部侍郎李式為戶部侍郎，充三司副使；

translations.literal: Li Shi, Vice Minister of Justice, was made Vice Minister of Revenue and appointed vice commissioner of the Three Departments;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi became Vice Minister of Revenue and vice commissioner of the Three Departments;

sentences.zh: 以禮部侍郎盧價為刑部侍郎；

translations.literal: Lu Jia, Vice Minister of Rites, was made Vice Minister of Justice;
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jia moved from Rites to Justice;

sentences.zh: 以樞密直學士、左散騎常侍邊光範為禮部侍郎充職。

translations.literal: Bian Guangfan, direct academician of Military Affairs and Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made Vice Minister of Rites while continuing in office.
translations.idiomatic: Bian Guangfan became Vice Minister of Rites while keeping his other posts.

sentences.zh: 〈（《宋史·邊光範傳》：少帝以光範藩邸舊僚，待遇尤厚。

translations.literal: (Biography of Bian Guangfan in the Song History: Emperor Shao, because Guangfan was an old staff member from his princely residence, treated him with especial favor.
translations.idiomatic: (Song History, biography of Bian Guangfan: Emperor Shao favored him greatly as a former staff member from his princely household.

sentences.zh: 因遊宴，見光範位翰林學士下，即日拜尚書禮部侍郎、知制誥，充翰林學士，仍直樞密使院。）〉

translations.literal: At a pleasure outing he saw Guangfan ranked below Hanlin academicians and that same day appointed him Vice Minister of Rites in the Department of State Affairs, drafter of rescripts, Hanlin Academician, and still on duty at the Bureau of Military Affairs.)〉
translations.idiomatic: At a banquet he saw Guangfan ranked below Hanlin scholars and that day made him Vice Minister of Rites, drafter, Hanlin academician, and still on duty at Military Affairs.)〉

sentences.zh: 辛未，以右龍武統軍周密為延州節度使。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Zhou Mi, commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, was made military commissioner of Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Zhou Mi became commissioner of Yan.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，河東節度使劉知遠奏，誅吐渾大首領白承福、白鐵匱、赫連海龍等，並夷其族凡四百口，蓋利其孳畜財寶也，人皆冤之。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Liu Zhiyuan, military commissioner of Hedong, reported the execution of the great Tuyuhun chiefs Bai Chengfu, Bai Tiegui, Helian Hailong, and others, and the extermination of their clans, four hundred persons in all—because he coveted their livestock and treasure—and people all deemed it unjust.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Liu Zhiyuan of Hedong reported executing Tuyuhun chiefs Bai Chengfu, Bai Tiegui, and Helian Hailong and wiping out four hundred of their kin for their herds and treasure—a deed widely deemed unjust.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以大理少卿劇可久為大理卿。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Ju Keyong, Vice Director of Judicial Review, was made Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Ju Keyong became Director of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 棣州刺史慕容彥超削奪在身官爵，房州安置，坐前任濮州擅出省倉麥及私賣官面，準法處死，太原節度使劉知遠上表救之，故貸其死。

translations.literal: Murong Yanchao, prefect of Di Prefecture, was stripped of his current rank and title and exiled to Fang Prefecture for having, while previously at Pu Prefecture, taken grain from the provincial granary without authorization and privately sold official flour; by law he deserved execution, but Liu Zhiyuan, military commissioner of Taiyuan, memorialized to save him, and therefore his life was spared.
translations.idiomatic: Di prefect Murong Yanchao was stripped of rank and exiled to Fang for embezzling Pu granary grain and selling official flour; Liu Zhiyuan of Taiyuan intervened and his life was spared.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，靈州馮暉奏，與威州刺史藥元福於威州土橋西一百里遇吐蕃七千餘人，大破之，斬首千餘級。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Feng Hui of Ling Prefecture reported that with Yao Yuanfu, prefect of Wei Prefecture, one hundred li west of the earthen bridge at Wei they met more than seven thousand Tibetans, routed them utterly, and took more than a thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Feng Hui of Ling reported that with Wei prefect Yao Yuanfu he met seven thousand Tibetans west of Wei's earthen bridge, routed them, and took a thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 是月，秦州雨，兩旬不止，鄴都雨水一丈，洛京、鄭州、貝州大水，鄴都、夏津臨清兩縣，餓死民凡三千三百。

translations.literal: That month Qin Prefecture had rain unceasing for twenty days; at Ye the rainwater reached one zhang; Luoyang, Zheng, and Bei prefectures suffered great floods; in the two counties of Xiajin and Linqing under Ye, three thousand three hundred people starved to death.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qin rained twenty days straight; Ye saw rainwater a zhang deep; Luoyang, Zheng, and Bei flooded; and three thousand three hundred starved in Xiajin and Linqing.

sentences.zh: 盜入臨濮、費縣。

translations.literal: Bandits entered Linpu and Fei counties.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits raided Linpu and Fei counties.

sentences.zh: 秋九月壬辰，鄆州節度使、侍衛親軍都指揮使李守貞加兼侍中，滑州節度使皇甫遇進封邠國公，相州節度使張彥澤加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, on renchen, Li Shouzhen, military commissioner of Yan Prefecture and commander of the Palace Guards Personal Army, was made concurrent Palace Attendant; Huangfu Yu, military commissioner of Hua Prefecture, was advanced to Duke of Bin; Zhang Yanze, military commissioner of Xiang Prefecture, was given acting Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen of the ninth autumn month Li Shouzhen of Yan became concurrent Palace Attendant, Huangfu Yu of Hua was made Duke of Bin, and Zhang Yanze of Xiang acting Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以權知威武軍節度使李宏達為檢校太尉、同平章事，充福建節度使，知閩國事。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Li Hongda, acting military commissioner of the Weiwu Army, was made acting Grand Marshal, Chief Counselor, military commissioner of Fujian, and overseer of Min affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Li Hongda of Weiwu became acting Grand Marshal, Chief Counselor, Fujian commissioner, and overseer of Min.

sentences.zh: 乙未，前商州刺史李俊賜自盡，坐與親妹奸及行劍斫殺女使，又殺部曲孫漢榮，強奸其妻，準法棄市，詔賜死於家。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Li Jun, former prefect of Shang Prefecture, was granted permission to take his own life for having committed incest with his younger sister by blood, drawn his sword and hacked a maid to death, also killed his retainer Sun Hanrong, and raped Sun's wife; by law he deserved execution in the marketplace, but an edict allowed him to die at home.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei former Shang prefect Li Jun was allowed to kill himself at home for incest with his sister, murdering a maid and retainer Sun Hanrong and raping Sun's wife—a capital crime commuted to death at home.

sentences.zh: 己亥，張彥澤奏，破蕃賊於定州界，斬首二十餘級，追襲百餘里，生擒蕃將四人，摘得金耳環二副進呈。

translations.literal: On jihai, Zhang Yanze reported breaking barbarian forces at the Ding Prefecture border, taking more than twenty heads, pursuing over a hundred li, capturing four barbarian generals alive, and presenting two pairs of gold earrings taken as trophies.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Zhang Yanze reported defeating barbarians on the Ding border, taking twenty heads, pursuing a hundred li, capturing four generals, and presenting gold earrings as trophies.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太原奏，破契丹於楊武谷，殺七千餘人。

translations.literal: On guimao, Taiyuan reported defeating the Khitan at Yangwu Valley and killing more than seven thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Taiyuan reported defeating the Khitan at Yangwu Valley with seven thousand killed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以天策上將軍、江南諸道都統、楚王馬希範兼諸道兵馬都元帥。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Ma Xifan, Grand General of the Heavenly Stratagem, overall commander of the Jiangnan circuits, and Prince of Chu, was made concurrent commander-in-chief of all circuits' armies and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Chu prince Ma Xifan became concurrent commander-in-chief of all circuits' forces.

sentences.zh: 詔開封府，以霖雨不止，應京城公私僦舍錢放一月。

translations.literal: An edict to Kaifeng Prefecture, because unending rains continued, ordered one month's rent remitted on public and private leased dwellings in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng was ordered to remit one month's rent on capital dwellings because of the endless rains.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔安審琦率兵赴鄴都，皇甫遇赴相州。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict ordered An Shenqi to lead troops to Ye and Huangfu Yu to Xiang Prefecture.
