translations.idiomatic: On yisi An Shenqi was ordered to Ye and Huangfu Yu to Xiang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以太子少保楊凝式為太子少傅，以刑部尚書王延為太子少保，前潁州團練使竇貞固為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Yang Ningshi, Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Senior Mentor; Wang Yan, Minister of Justice, was made Junior Mentor; Dou Zhengu, former training commissioner of Ying Prefecture, was made Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Yang Ningshi became Senior Mentor, Wang Yan Junior Mentor, and former Ying commissioner Dou Zhengu Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 是月，河南、河北、關西諸州奏，大水霖雨不止，溝河泛濫，水入城郭及損害秋稼。

translations.literal: That month Henan, Hebei, and the western passes reported that great floods and unending rains made ditches and rivers overflow, water entered cities, and the autumn grain was harmed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Henan, Hebei, and the western passes reported floods, endless rain, cities inundated, and crops ruined.

sentences.zh: 是月，契丹瀛州刺史詐為書與樂壽將軍王巒，願以本城歸順，且言城中蕃軍不滿千人，請朝廷發軍襲取之，己為內應。

translations.literal: That month the Khitan prefect of Ying Prefecture forged a letter to Wang Luan, general of Leshou, offering to surrender the city and stating that barbarian troops in the city numbered fewer than a thousand, asking the court to send an army to seize it while he served as insider.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Khitan prefect of Ying forged a letter to Leshou general Wang Luan offering surrender, claiming fewer than a thousand barbarian troops in the city and asking for a strike while he acted as insider.

sentences.zh: 又云：「今秋苦雨，川澤漲溢，自瓦橋已北，水勢無際。

translations.literal: He also wrote: "This autumn's bitter rains have made rivers and marshes overflow; from Wagiao Bridge northward the waters are boundless.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: "This autumn's rains have flooded the rivers; north of Wagiao Bridge the waters are endless.

sentences.zh: 契丹已歸本國，若聞南夏有變，地遠阻水，雖欲奔命，無能及也。」

translations.literal: The Khitan have already returned to their own country; if they hear trouble in the Southern Court, the distance and the blocking waters mean that even if they wished to rush to the rescue, they could not arrive in time."
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan have returned home; if they hear of trouble in the south, distance and flood would prevent any timely rescue."

sentences.zh: 又，巒繼有密奏，苦言瀛、鄚可取之狀。

translations.literal: Moreover Luan sent further secret memorials urgently arguing that Ying and Mo could be taken.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Luan also sent secret memorials urgently arguing that Ying and Mo could be taken.

sentences.zh: 先是，前歲中車駕駐於河上，曾遣邊將遺書於幽州趙延壽，勸令歸國，延壽尋有報命，依違而已。

translations.literal: Earlier, the year before when the imperial carriage was stationed on the Yellow River, border generals had been sent with letters to Zhao Yanshou at Youzhou urging him to return to the realm; Yanshou soon sent a reply, evasive and noncommittal.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the emperor had been on the Yellow River, border generals wrote Zhao Yanshou at Youzhou urging return; his reply was evasive.

sentences.zh: 是歲三月，復遣鄴都杜威致書於延壽，且述朝旨，啖以厚利，仍遣洺州軍將趙行實賫書而往，潛申款密。

translations.literal: In the third month of this year Du Wei of Ye was again sent with a letter to Yanshou stating court policy, tempting him with rich rewards, and the Luozhou officer Zhao Xingshi was dispatched bearing the letter to convey secret pledges in private.
translations.idiomatic: That third month Du Wei of Ye again wrote Yanshou with court policy and rich inducements, sending Luozhou officer Zhao Xingshi with secret pledges.

sentences.zh: 行實曾事延壽，故遣之。

translations.literal: Xingshi had once served Yanshou, and therefore was sent.
translations.idiomatic: Xingshi had once served Yanshou and was chosen for the mission.

sentences.zh: 七月，行實自燕回，得延壽書，且言：「久陷邊庭，願歸中國，乞發大軍應接，即拔身南去。」

translations.literal: In the seventh month Xingshi returned from Yan with Yanshou's letter, which also stated: "Long trapped on the frontier, I wish to return to China; I beg that a great army be sent to meet me, and I will at once withdraw south."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Xingshi returned from Yan with Yanshou's letter: "Long trapped on the frontier, I wish to return to China; send a great army to meet me and I will come south at once."

sentences.zh: 敘致懇切，辭旨綿密，時朝廷欣然從之，復遣趙行實計會延壽大軍應接之所。

translations.literal: The tone was earnest and the wording close and careful; the court then gladly agreed and again sent Zhao Xingshi to arrange where Yanshou's great army should be met.
translations.idiomatic: The tone was earnest; the court gladly agreed and again sent Zhao Xingshi to arrange the rendezvous.

sentences.zh: 有瀛州大將遣所親賫蠟書至闕下，告雲欲謀翻變，以本城歸命。

translations.literal: A great general of Ying Prefecture sent a close associate bearing a sealed wax letter to the court reporting a planned mutiny to surrender the city.
translations.idiomatic: A Ying general sent a sealed letter to court reporting a planned mutiny to surrender the city.

sentences.zh: 未幾，會彼有告變者，事不果就。

translations.literal: Before long someone there reported the plot, and the affair did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the plot was reported on the other side and came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 至是，瀛州守將劉延祚受契丹之命，詐輸誠款，以誘我軍，國家深以為信，遂有出師之議。

translations.literal: At this time Liu Yanzuo, the Ying garrison commander, on Khitan orders feigned sincere submission to lure our army; the state deeply trusted him, and therefore the debate to march troops arose.
translations.idiomatic: Now Ying commander Liu Yanzuo, on Khitan orders, feigned surrender to lure our army; the court believed him, and the campaign was launched.
